title: Computer graphics–based generation of dynamic 3D Bangla sign language animations via HamNoSys-to-SiGML conversion
core_idea: A system that converts Bangla text or voice into dynamic 3D Bangla Sign Language (BdSL) animations by translating linguistic input through HamNoSys-to-SiGML conversion to drive a computer-graphics animation engine; it covers gestures for numbers, alphabets and word motions, spells out unseen inputs letter-by-letter, and parses text using linguistic principles to capture handshape, palm orientation and non-manual signals.
tldr: Transforms Bangla text or voice into 3D BdSL animations via HamNoSys→SiGML conversion and graphics rendering to enable flexible sign language generation.
